author: duy90
text:
Here is the progress I made

For monthly, I will explain what happens as best as I can

1. The base is formed, after a drop from history. With the limited history I have, I cannot pinpoint, where the price would return at 2nd point, however It is around the area marked in red. There was a possible Fail to return (henceforth FTR) Engulf at 2nd point as well (Cannot be 100% sure, as there are no history beyond this time for me). Regardless, the price turned back down. Where did it come back to? Previous base, marked by 1.

2. The base is formed and possible engulf of previous FTR is made, suggesting price wants to go higher

3. The price returns to the Demand level marked with 1 Forming First time back (Henceforth FTB) previous supply, to pinpoint where it would turn, one could have drawn and FTR level on this Supply. The price then moves to 4th point

4. The price stopped at possible previous Supply level, however because I have limited history, I marked as it broke previous Resistance (Henceforth R) level, therefore is now Demand level, Would look to sell once it retraces back to this level, happens in point 8.

5. The price made lowest low of all time according to the chart, and strongly pushed the price back to Demand turning into Supply level.

6. Looking to short, however not looking to earn many pips, as the price shot back to 1.

If looking only at monthly chart, there was no pinpoint entry. However at point 6 one could have sold to the Support below, as there is now Demand looking at the wick formed making lowest low.

7. The previous Supply has been broken and suggest price wants to go Higher, also FTR is confirmed, therefore looking for Buy on FTB

8. Breaks previous R on 4th point, suggesting price wants to go even higher

9. FTB of FTR formed at 7th point

10. Price engulfs previous high, however Flags right after it creating a Cap. Flag suggests the end of momentum. Therefore we cannot expect price to go much higher

11. Price compresses up, therefore Insitutions (Henceforth IT) are now adding small positions to get ready to go short, however we shall wait for engulf of the Price action zone which happens at 12. Compressed Price action zone is engulfed and the price broke out of CP channel. Now we look to go short on Retracement

12. New demand zone is formed

13. Price goes up to test the last decision point, where the break was made. It bounces

14. Price engulfs the test made in 13th point and reaches the edge of Supply + Channel

15. Short here as planned in step 11.

16. Price reaches the previous FTR made during step 12

17. Then price shoots up, When this kind of move happens, expect the price to compress as market is now confused

18. Price reaches the end of Demand level formed in step 12, and engulfs it, Price wants to go lower. However to break the level, they need buy orders, therefore IT pushes the price back to previous Supply level, which is FTR formed at step 15 19. Price got rejected and is the way down.

Extra. I believe the price will do what marked in Red line because, the price engulfed CP zone at step 12 and at step 18 the price broke previous low, suggesting price wants to go lower. 18-19 Price shot up from CP zone as excepted, however because they made it look bullish like that, there is likely lots of buyers, therefore IT plans to sell as they sent the signal already. Before they sell, they have to re-test the previous level where the decision was made - the rejection at step 19. The price may not go all the way up to the RED box 19, however it will bounce up a little bit, causing more buyers to jump in.

I hope others can give me an insight on my analysis

I hope my analysis is correct

author: Kanzler
text:
Good work kouta01, I like how you took a closer look at the swing highs and lows and identified the true supply or demand. db, same for you - excellent work, keep it up!

duy90 wrote: Thx for the tip Kanzler, How should I mark CP area then? Those channels are for me CP areas, not the trend to follow:D

Regards, Duy

I usually mark CP by a line marking the highs or lows where supply/demand is being tested, it shows you what's going on without making presumptions. You can predict where CP might break but you need to look at potential flag limits and mark those up and then see what PA does when it reaches that area. Price needs to engulf into the CP for it to show intent to reverse.
